description:
Why this issue exists: server.rs build_mta_sts_policy_body() uses write!(&mut buf, ...).expect('write to String failed'). Writing to a String cannot fail (it only fails for I/O streams), so the expect is dead code, but the pattern obscures intent. The function signature returns a plain String, which requires the expect to compile.

What needs to be done: Use string formatting directly: format!(...) calls assembled with push_str, or use a single format! that builds the whole policy text. This removes the spurious infallible-expect and makes it clear the operation cannot fail.
title: build_mta_sts_policy_body: write!/expect pattern; should return Result
